_about: Drawn 3D board for site/boardviz (docs/how-to-contribute.md, Add a board drawing). Millimeters from the board's bottom-left corner, x right, y up (the user-guide picture, pin 1 at the top left), rot in degrees counterclockwise. The two socket parts j1 and j2 sit underneath (side bottom) at the same pitch as the LaunchPad kit's j1 and j2, so a scene can mate them. Parts of type lcd, joystick, tact, buzzer, mic and rgbled are drawn in site/boardviz/boardviz.js.
source: Positions read from the board picture in the BoosterPack's user guide (SLAU599, figure 1-1); scale set from the 2.54 mm header pitch. Pin names from the user guide's header tables.

parts.label: Left sockets
parts.title: J1 and J3 sockets underneath
parts.text: Two rows of ten sockets on the underside. They press onto the LaunchPad kit's left headers, pin 1 at the top.

parts.label: Right sockets
parts.title: J4 and J2 sockets underneath
parts.text: Two rows of ten sockets on the underside. They press onto the LaunchPad kit's right headers, pin 40 at the top.

parts.label: J1 and J3 pins
parts.title: Left header pins
parts.text: The same 20 pins come up through the top, so you can probe them or plug another board on.

parts.label: J4 and J2 pins
parts.title: Right header pins
parts.text: The right 20 pins, numbered 40 down to 31 and 20 down to 11 as printed on the board.

parts.label: Screen
parts.title: 128 x 128 color screen
parts.text: A color screen with an ST7735S controller, 128 by 128 pixels, no touch. The program draws on it over SPI.

parts.label: Joystick
parts.title: Analog joystick
parts.text: Two analog axes and a push. The program reads it to move around and to press.

parts.label: S1
parts.title: Button S1
parts.text: A push button on header pin 33.

parts.label: S2
parts.title: Button S2
parts.text: A push button on header pin 32.

parts.label: Buzzer
parts.title: Buzzer
parts.text: A small buzzer on header pin 40.

parts.label: Microphone
parts.title: Microphone
parts.text: An analog microphone on header pin 6.

parts.label: RGB LED
parts.title: Color LED
parts.text: One LED with red, green and blue parts, on header pins 39, 38 and 37.

parts.name: 5V PWR
parts.label: 5V PWR
parts.title: 5 V power light
parts.text: Lights when the pack gets 5 V from the LaunchPad.

parts.name: 3V3 PWR
parts.label: 3V3 PWR
parts.title: 3.3 V power light
parts.text: Lights when the pack gets 3.3 V from the LaunchPad.

parts.label: Accelerometer
parts.title: Accelerometer
parts.text: A 3-axis analog accelerometer on header pins 23, 24 and 25.

parts.label: Light sensor
parts.title: Light sensor
parts.text: An OPT3001 light sensor on the I2C pins 9 and 10, with its alert on pin 8.

parts.label: J5 jumper
parts.title: J5, red LED or backlight
parts.text: Picks what header pin 39 drives: the red LED (pins 1 and 2) or the screen backlight (pins 2 and 3).

parts.label: Servo header
parts.title: J8, servo header
parts.text: Ground, power and signal for a hobby servo. The signal is header pin 19.

parts.label: Gator hole
parts.title: Gator-clip pad
parts.text: A pad for an alligator clip: touch it to read as a button.
